supplements.name: Astaxanthin

interactions.title: Extreme Bleeding Risk: 10+ Anticoagulant & Fibrinolytic Mechanisms
interactions.description: This stack layers 10+ blood-thinning mechanisms: nattokinase (400 mg / 12,000 FU — fibrinolytic), serrapeptase in TWO products (155 mg combined — fibrinolytic), bromelain, aged garlic (7,500 mg — blood thinner), krill oil (omega-3s), curcumin from THREE sources, black seed oil, resveratrol now from TWO sources (760 mg total — antiplatelet), quercetin (160 mg — antiplatelet), and astaxanthin (mild antiplatelet). This is an exceptionally dangerous compounding of anticoagulant/fibrinolytic mechanisms.
interactions.recommendation: This combination requires immediate physician review. The stacking of nattokinase + serrapeptase + bromelain + garlic + curcumin + 760 mg resveratrol creates serious hemorrhage risk. Physician must review before any surgery.

interactions.title: Vitamin D3 Toxicity Risk at 100,000 IU/day
interactions.description: 100,000 IU daily of D3 is far above the upper tolerable intake of 4,000 IU/day and even above the weekly bolus doses (50,000 IU/week) used therapeutically. This can cause hypercalcemia — dangerously high calcium levels leading to kidney stones, arterial calcification, nausea, confusion, and cardiac arrhythmias. While K2 helps direct calcium away from arteries, it cannot fully compensate for this level of D3. The multivitamin adds another ~800 IU.
interactions.recommendation: Require serum 25(OH)D and calcium levels. This dose should only be used short-term under medical supervision for documented severe deficiency.

interactions.title: Iodine Intake: Adequate but Monitor with Multivitamin
interactions.description: 300 mcg of iodine is about 2x the RDA (150 mcg) and well below the upper tolerable limit (1,100 mcg). The multivitamin adds additional iodine, so combined intake should be monitored to stay below the UL.
interactions.recommendation: Safe at this dose. Monitor total iodine intake from all supplements combined.

interactions.title: Zinc-Copper Imbalance (Now ~126 mg Zinc)
interactions.description: Zinc from all sources: picolinate 100 mg + multi 7.5 mg + Snap prostate 11 mg + blood sugar formula 7.5 mg = ~126 mg total. This is 3x the upper tolerable limit (40 mg). Total copper is only ~3.65 mg (Thorne 2 mg + multi 0.75 mg + Snap 0.9 mg). The zinc:copper ratio is ~35:1 vs. the ideal 10-15:1. Chronic high zinc causes copper deficiency anemia and neurological damage.
interactions.recommendation: Reduce zinc to 30-50 mg/day total. At minimum, consolidate zinc sources and increase copper.

interactions.title: GI-Irritating Combination: Oregano + Garlic + Turmeric
interactions.description: Oil of oregano (6,000 mg — extremely high) is caustic to the GI lining. Aged garlic at 7,500 mg and turmeric/ginger can also irritate the stomach. Combined, these dramatically increase the risk of GI ulceration, gastritis, and discomfort.
interactions.recommendation: Reduce oregano oil dose significantly. Take with food and consider spacing doses apart.

interactions.title: Multiple Blood-Pressure-Lowering Agents
interactions.description: This stack contains numerous agents that lower blood pressure: magnesium (vasodilator), potassium (counteracts sodium), olive leaf/oleuropein (ACE-inhibitor-like), beetroot (nitric oxide), aged garlic (vasodilator), moringa (blood-pressure-lowering), and black seed oil (antihypertensive). Taking all of these together may cause excessive blood pressure drops, dizziness, and fainting, especially when standing.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure regularly. If already on BP medication, this combination could cause dangerous hypotension.

interactions.title: Extreme Blood-Sugar-Lowering Stack: Hypoglycemia Risk
interactions.description: This stack now contains an extraordinary number of hypoglycemic agents: berberine (BurnSlim — metformin-equivalent), PLUS gymnema sylvestre (blocks sugar taste and absorption), bitter melon (insulin-mimetic), banaba leaf (corosolic acid — glucose transporter activator), cinnamon (insulin sensitizer), alpha lipoic acid (glucose uptake), white mulberry (alpha-glucosidase inhibitor) — all from the blood sugar formula. Add moringa, black seed oil, chromium from TWO sources (~116 mcg total), and ALCAR. This is comparable to stacking multiple diabetes medications.
interactions.recommendation: Serious hypoglycemia risk, especially when fasting or exercising. If not diabetic, this level of blood sugar suppression is potentially dangerous. Requires glucose monitoring.

interactions.title: Boron Above Upper Tolerable Limit
interactions.description: 25 mg of boron exceeds the UL of 20 mg/day. The multivitamin adds another 1.2 mg. Total ~26.2 mg. While boron supports testosterone and bone metabolism, excess can cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and at very high doses, reproductive toxicity.
interactions.recommendation: Reduce to 3-10 mg/day unless directed by a physician.

interactions.title: Immune Stimulation Overload
interactions.description: An extraordinary number of immune-stimulating and antimicrobial compounds. Elderberry and echinacea are immune activators. Oregano oil, garlic, and black seed oil are antimicrobials. The antimicrobial blend adds cat's claw (immune stimulant), sweet wormwood (artemisinin), cryptolepis, and Chinese skullcap. For someone with autoimmune conditions, this level of immune stimulation could trigger or worsen flares.
interactions.recommendation: If there is any autoimmune history, consult an immunologist. The antimicrobial load from this many sources may also devastate beneficial gut flora.

interactions.title: Hormonal Stack Interactions (6+ Products)
interactions.description: Testosterone/hormonal support from 6+ products: Atlas X (horny goat weed, fenugreek, tongkat ali, nettle, citrulline), Pulse Male (arginine, citrulline — NO/erection support), Snap Prostate (saw palmetto, nettle, beta-sitosterol), Himalayan Shilajit (tribulus, mucuna pruriens, ashwagandha, ginseng), standalone boron (25 mg) and saw palmetto (450 mg). Saw palmetto from TWO sources. Nettle from TWO sources. DHT-blocking from multiple angles. Mucuna pruriens raises dopamine which drives testosterone. Tribulus and ginseng are classic testosterone boosters. Unpredictable combined hormonal effects.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor hormone levels (total/free testosterone, DHT, estradiol, SHBG). Six overlapping hormonal products means much higher effective doses than any single label suggests.

interactions.title: Iron Absorption Blocked by Zinc, EGCG, and Minerals
interactions.description: The Codeage multi contains iron (27.5 mg). Zinc (~126 mg total), calcium, and magnesium all compete with iron for absorption. Green tea EGCG (in Snap Prostate, 45% of 500 mg antioxidant blend) is a potent iron absorption inhibitor. The combined mineral competition plus EGCG chelation may render the iron supplementation almost entirely ineffective.
interactions.recommendation: Take iron 2+ hours away from zinc, calcium, magnesium, and green tea. Or take iron with vitamin C to enhance absorption.

interactions.title: Piperine from 4 Sources Amplifies Everything
interactions.description: Black pepper / piperine now appears in FOUR products: turmeric blend, beetroot blend, BurnSlim (cayenne), and the antimicrobial blend (5 mg at 95% piperine). Piperine inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, increasing bioavailability of many compounds by 30-2,000%. This means berberine, curcumin, resveratrol, and virtually everything else in this stack may have significantly amplified effects. With this many sources, the cumulative piperine dose creates unpredictable potentiation of already-high doses.
interactions.recommendation: The piperine load is turning every other dose in this stack into an effectively higher dose. This is especially dangerous for berberine and the blood-thinning agents.

interactions.title: Oil of Oregano vs. Probiotics
interactions.description: Oil of oregano at 6,000 mg is a potent broad-spectrum antimicrobial that kills both harmful and beneficial bacteria. Taking it with probiotics (from the probiotic blend and the Codeage multi) is counterproductive — the oregano oil will likely kill the probiotic organisms before they can colonize.
interactions.recommendation: If using oil of oregano, take probiotics at least 4-6 hours apart, or use oregano in short courses rather than continuously.

interactions.title: Redundant Olive Leaf & Moringa Sources
interactions.description: Olive leaf extract appears standalone (680 mg), as oleuropein (50 mg), and in BurnSlim (20% oleuropein olive leaf). Moringa appears standalone (1,000 mg) and in BurnSlim. This creates unnecessarily high and unpredictable total doses of both compounds, amplifying the blood-pressure-lowering and blood-sugar-lowering effects.
interactions.recommendation: Consolidate sources. Choose either standalone olive leaf or BurnSlim, not both.

interactions.title: Fenugreek Duplication
interactions.description: Fenugreek appears in both the Atlas X blend (200 mg) and the Codeage Men's Vitality blend. Fenugreek has estrogenic compounds (diosgenin) and can affect both testosterone and estrogen levels. Double-dosing amplifies the unpredictability of hormonal effects.
interactions.recommendation: Account for total fenugreek intake from all sources.

interactions.title: Chromium from 3 Sources
interactions.description: Chromium from multi (40 mcg) + blood sugar formula (76 mcg) = 116 mcg total. While below the NOAEL, chromium supplementation combined with the extensive blood-sugar-lowering stack amplifies hypoglycemia risk. Chromium picolinate at high doses has been associated with kidney and liver toxicity in case reports.
interactions.recommendation: The chromium itself is within safe limits, but its glucose-lowering effect adds to an already aggressive blood sugar stack.

interactions.title: Massive Nitric Oxide Stack: Citrulline + Arginine + Beetroot
interactions.description: L-Citrulline now from TWO products: Atlas X (200 mg) + Pulse Male (200 mg total from HCl and Malate forms). L-Arginine from Pulse Male (400 mg total from base and AKG forms). Beetroot nitrates also convert to NO. Combined with other vasodilators (magnesium, garlic, olive leaf), this is a substantial nitric oxide production stack that could cause excessive vasodilation, headaches, and blood pressure drops.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure. Be cautious combining with the multiple BP-lowering agents already in the stack.

interactions.title: Synergistic: D3 + K2 + Magnesium + Boron
interactions.description: This is a well-designed synergistic combination. K2 directs D3-mobilized calcium to bones and away from arteries. Magnesium is required for D3 metabolism (converts D3 to active 1,25-dihydroxy form). Boron reduces urinary calcium and magnesium loss. However, the D3 dose itself is the concern — the support stack is good.
interactions.recommendation: Good combination — just address the D3 dose.

interactions.title: Synergistic: Complete B-Vitamin Coverage
interactions.description: The standalone B vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B6, B12) plus those in the multivitamin provide thorough B-complex coverage. B vitamins work synergistically and are water-soluble (excess is excreted). Benfotiamine (B1) and P5P (B6) are superior bioavailable forms. Methylcobalamin (B12) is the active form. This is a well-constructed B-vitamin protocol.
interactions.recommendation: Good selection of forms. Monitor B6 total intake — keep under 100 mg/day long-term to avoid neuropathy.

interactions.title: Synergistic: Glutathione + Vitamin C
interactions.description: Vitamin C recycles oxidized glutathione back to its active reduced form. Liposomal glutathione has better absorption than standard. This is a solid antioxidant foundation.
interactions.recommendation: Good combination for antioxidant support.

interactions.title: Licorice Root Raises Blood Pressure & Depletes Potassium
interactions.description: The blood sugar formula contains licorice root extract, which inhibits 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase, causing cortisol to activate mineralocorticoid receptors. This raises blood pressure, causes potassium wasting, and fluid retention — directly COUNTERACTING the potassium supplement (1,020 mg), magnesium, olive leaf, and garlic that are all trying to lower BP. Licorice-induced hypokalemia combined with potassium supplementation creates unpredictable electrolyte swings that can affect heart rhythm.
interactions.recommendation: Licorice root is a serious concern in a stack that simultaneously tries to lower BP and supplement potassium. It should be removed or the blood sugar formula should be replaced with one without licorice.

interactions.title: Wormwood + Oregano 6,000mg: Liver Toxicity Concern
interactions.description: Sweet wormwood (artemisinin, 200 mg) is hepatotoxic with prolonged use. Combined with oil of oregano (6,000 mg — also hepatotoxic at high doses), this creates compounding liver stress. Cat's claw in the same blend can also affect liver enzymes. These should not be taken daily long-term.
interactions.recommendation: Limit antimicrobial blend and oregano oil to short courses (2-4 weeks). Monitor liver enzymes (ALT, AST) if using chronically.

interactions.title: Duplicate Serrapeptase + Nattokinase: Double Fibrinolytic Load
interactions.description: Serrapeptase appears in TWO products: spike support (100 mg / 360,000 SPU) and antimicrobial blend (55 mg / 2,000 SPU per mg = 110,000 SPU). Total serrapeptase ~155 mg / ~470,000 SPU. Combined with nattokinase (400 mg / 12,000 FU), this is an extremely potent fibrinolytic cocktail that dissolves blood clots. Adding this to the existing garlic and curcumin anticoagulants makes the bleeding risk severe.
interactions.recommendation: Do not take both products simultaneously. Choose one source of fibrinolytic enzymes and take it separately from blood-thinning agents.

interactions.title: Duplicate Saw Palmetto & Nettle from Multiple Products
interactions.description: Saw palmetto: standalone 450 mg PLUS Snap Prostate urinary blend (45% fatty acids, from 600 mg blend). Nettle: Atlas X 100 mg PLUS Snap Prostate urinary blend. Both are 5-alpha-reductase inhibitors that block DHT conversion. Double-dosing of DHT blockers can cause sexual side effects, breast tenderness, or mood changes similar to finasteride (a prescription DHT blocker).
interactions.recommendation: Use ONE source of saw palmetto and nettle, not three products containing them.

interactions.title: Cat's Claw May Amplify Immune-Suppressing Effects
interactions.description: Cat's claw (250 mg, 4% oxindole alkaloids) is an immune modulator that can both stimulate and suppress immune function depending on the alkaloid type. Pentacyclic oxindole alkaloids (POAs) stimulate immunity, while tetracyclic (TOAs) suppress it. Without knowing the alkaloid profile, combining with other immune stimulants (echinacea, elderberry) creates unpredictable immune modulation.
interactions.recommendation: Verify the cat's claw product specifies POA-dominant (immune-stimulating) if that is the intent.

interactions.title: Resveratrol + Curcumin: CYP Enzyme Inhibition Stack
interactions.description: Japanese knotweed (800 mg, 20% resveratrol = ~160 mg resveratrol) and curcumin from multiple sources both inhibit CYP enzymes (1A2, 2C9, 2D6, 3A4). Combined with piperine (which also inhibits CYP3A4), this can significantly slow the metabolism of medications and other substances, effectively increasing their half-life and blood levels.
interactions.recommendation: Be aware that medications and other drugs may stay in the system longer due to CYP inhibition from multiple sources.

interactions.title: Magnesium from 5+ Sources: Total ~400 mg Elemental
interactions.description: Magnesium now from 5 sources: L-threonate (~144 mg elemental), glycinate (~50 mg), multi (15 mg), Snap prostate (60 mg citrate, ~10 mg elemental), blood sugar formula (125 mg oxide, ~5 mg elemental at oxide's low bioavailability). Total supplemental elemental Mg ~224 mg, within the 350 mg UL, but combined with dietary intake may cause osmotic diarrhea.
interactions.recommendation: Spread magnesium doses throughout the day. Magnesium oxide has poor bioavailability — the blood sugar formula's form is not contributing much.

interactions.title: Trans Resveratrol 600 mg Adds Major Antiplatelet Load
interactions.description: The NAD combo adds 600 mg of trans-resveratrol — a potent antiplatelet agent — on top of the 160 mg resveratrol already in the antimicrobial blend (800 mg Japanese knotweed at 20%). Total resveratrol is now ~760 mg. Combined with nattokinase, serrapeptase, garlic, krill oil, and curcumin, the bleeding risk is now even more extreme than before.
interactions.recommendation: This dramatically worsens the already-critical bleeding risk. The resveratrol dose alone is comparable to clinical trial doses that showed significant platelet inhibition.

interactions.title: Vitamin D Now 101,000+ IU from Two Sources
interactions.description: The Sea Moss Gummies add 1,000 IU of Vitamin D3 on top of the existing 100,000 IU standalone dose and ~800 IU from the multivitamin. Total D3 is now over 101,800 IU/day — making an already dangerous overdose even higher.
interactions.recommendation: The additional 1,000 IU is trivial next to 100,000 IU, but it shows how supplements keep stacking without awareness of totals.

interactions.title: Shilajit Adds 6th Hormonal Product to the Stack
interactions.description: The Himalayan Shilajit product contains tribulus terrestris (testosterone booster), mucuna pruriens (dopamine/testosterone), ashwagandha (cortisol/testosterone), and Panax ginseng (hormonal adaptogen). This is the 6th product with testosterone-boosting claims, joining Atlas X, Pulse Male, Snap Prostate, standalone boron, and standalone saw palmetto. The combined hormonal manipulation from this many angles is completely unpredictable.
interactions.recommendation: Six overlapping hormonal products is excessive. Consolidate to 1-2 products. Monitor testosterone, DHT, estradiol, and prolactin levels.

interactions.title: Ashwagandha from 2 Sources + Adaptogens Lower BP Further
interactions.description: Ashwagandha appears in both the Shilajit product (40 mg) and Sea Moss Gummies. Ashwagandha lowers blood pressure and cortisol. Combined with Panax ginseng (from Shilajit) which also affects BP, plus the existing stack of potassium, olive leaf, garlic, beetroot, and magnesium, the hypotension risk keeps growing.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure closely. The adaptogens add another BP-lowering mechanism on top of an already-aggressive stack.

interactions.title: Sea Moss Gummies Add More Immune Stimulants
interactions.description: The Sea Moss Gummies contain elderberry, black seed, turmeric, and moringa — all of which already appear as standalone supplements. This adds ANOTHER source of elderberry (now from 2 products), black seed (now from 2 products), turmeric (now from 3+ products), and moringa (now from 3+ products). The total immune stimulation load continues to climb.
interactions.recommendation: Serious redundancy. The gummies duplicate multiple ingredients already taken at much higher standalone doses.

interactions.title: Sea Moss Gummies Add 5th Source of Piperine/Black Pepper
interactions.description: The Sea Moss Gummies contain black pepper, making it the 5th product with piperine. Each source amplifies absorption of everything else in the stack by inhibiting CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. The cumulative piperine dose is now even more unpredictable, making effective doses of berberine, curcumin, resveratrol, and other compounds significantly higher than the labels suggest.
interactions.recommendation: Five sources of piperine means every other supplement in this stack has amplified, unpredictable absorption. This compounds every other interaction.

interactions.title: Shilajit + Sea Moss Add More Glucose-Lowering Agents
interactions.description: Shilajit lowers blood sugar through fulvic acid and chromium content. Sea moss gummies add turmeric, moringa, and ACV — all glucose-lowering. These join the already-massive blood sugar stack (berberine, gymnema, bitter melon, cinnamon, banaba, ALA, chromium, black seed oil, moringa, ALCAR). The hypoglycemia risk continues to grow with each new product.
interactions.recommendation: The blood sugar lowering redundancy is extreme. Monitor glucose levels, especially when fasting.

interactions.title: CoQ10 from 3 Sources: ~225 mg Total
interactions.description: CoQ10 now from the NAD combo (100 mg), multivitamin (25 mg), and naturally in beef organs. Total supplemental CoQ10 ~125 mg plus dietary. While CoQ10 is generally safe, it has mild blood-pressure-lowering and blood-thinning effects that add to this stack's existing load.
interactions.recommendation: CoQ10 is generally beneficial but note its contributions to BP-lowering and blood-thinning in this context.

interactions.title: Rhodiola + Saffron: Serotonin & Dopamine Overlap
interactions.description: Rhodiola rosea increases serotonin and dopamine by inhibiting MAO enzymes. Saffron also affects serotonin reuptake (similar mechanism to SSRIs). Together they create a mild serotonergic combination. If combined with any antidepressant medication, there is a risk of serotonin syndrome — symptoms include agitation, rapid heartbeat, high temperature, and muscle twitching.
interactions.recommendation: Safe together at these doses for most people, but do NOT combine with SSRI/SNRI antidepressants without physician approval.

interactions.title: Synergistic: TMG + B12 + Folate Methylation Support
interactions.description: TMG (trimethylglycine) donates methyl groups to convert homocysteine to methionine. B12 and folate (from the multi) support the same pathway via a different route. Together they provide comprehensive methylation support — important for DNA repair, detox, and cardiovascular health. TMG also helps compensate for methyl group depletion from NAD/NMN supplementation.
interactions.recommendation: Good synergy, especially alongside the NAD supplement. The TMG dose is appropriate.

interactions.title: Synergistic: Astaxanthin + Glutathione + Vitamin C
interactions.description: Astaxanthin is one of the most potent antioxidants found in nature, working in both water- and fat-soluble environments. Combined with glutathione (the body's master antioxidant) and vitamin C (which recycles glutathione), this trio provides excellent multi-layer antioxidant protection.
interactions.recommendation: Strong antioxidant combination. Astaxanthin at 12 mg is a well-studied, safe dose.

interactions.title: Astaxanthin + Quercetin Add to Antiplatelet Load
interactions.description: Astaxanthin has mild antiplatelet effects. Quercetin (160 mg in the NAD combo) also inhibits platelet aggregation. While individually these are minor, they add yet more antiplatelet mechanisms to a stack already containing garlic, krill oil, resveratrol (760 mg total), nattokinase, serrapeptase, and curcumin. Every additional antiplatelet compound increases the cumulative bleeding risk.
interactions.recommendation: Individually safe, but in this stack they contribute to an already-extreme anticoagulant load.
